lines.text: The commanders and all the people ask Jeremiah to pray that the LORD will tell them the way to walk.
Jeremiah promises to withhold nothing from the people, and they vow to obey the LORD whether His answer is pleasant or unpleasant.
After forty days the word of the LORD comes to Jeremiah, and he summons Johanan, the commanders and all the people.
The LORD says if they stay in the land He will build them up, but they say they will go to Moab.
The LORD warns that those who go to Egypt will die by sword, famine and plague, and Jeremiah says they have deceived themselves.
